collection.description: A parent wonders whether distant people raise children in households of many shapes.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A parent wonders whether distant people raise children in households of many shapes, with relatives, friends, or chosen caregivers.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: An elder praises the thought of many trusted adults helping a child grow.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A parent warns that more caregivers can also mean disagreements about responsibility.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A villager admires the privacy of a home with only one or two people.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Another worries about loneliness when help is far away.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The group agrees that safety and dependable care matter more than one household pattern.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A child asks who gets to decide what counts as family.
